title: agrostis griffithiana
intro: Agrostis griffithiana, commonly known as Griffith's bent grass, is a type of plant species in the family Poaceae. The plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis griffithiana include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
